capability: No claim without an example you can try
title: Show one real example.

hook.picture: Close: a pod hands the whale a claim card with an empty socket. The whale tries it and nothing happens, ✕.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: It said a fix exists. It couldn't show me one.
problem_in_viewer_words.who: student asking an AI assistant for help

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Claim cards stream in from pods with bold tabs and empty sockets. Three times, faster each time, the whale tries one and nothing happens.

stakes.body: Time goes into chasing fixes that were only ever promised, and confident claims are believed without anything to try.

solution_hint: Ask for one example you can try.

metaphor.body: A claim is a card with a socket for an example. A gate refuses claims whose socket is empty, so every claim arrives with something you can try.

steps.picture: A gate rises with an example-card icon on its lintel. A claim with an empty socket arrives, and the bar drops.
steps.sound: A key with no click: stop

steps.picture: A claim with an example card snapped into its socket passes. The opening glows.
Push-in: the whale lifts the example card out and tries it on the line. The broken spot mends. Tick.
steps.sound: The lock opens on a chord

steps.picture: Empty claims keep stopping at the gate. Filled ones pass.
The example card glows in its socket.
The whale holds up the card.
steps.words: An example you can try: a witness.

real_case.claim: Illustration. The intuitionistic-logic-framework plugin (/ilf:witness plus 5 other commands) is v0.1.0, an initial release that 'Needs real-world validation'. There are no results to show yet.

honest_limit.picture: A claim arrives with an example that fits the socket but shows a different line. It passes, and it doesn't mend the whale's line.
honest_limit.words: An example can answer the wrong question.

not_this.body: One example shows it exists. Not best.

ending_pattern.body: The same pod hands over the same claim, now with an example in its socket. The whale tries it and its line mends.
ending_pattern.callback: Same close framing and pod as bar 1: the empty socket is now filled and the example works.

end_belief.body: When it says it exists, ask for one.
